ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: Outposts Expanded Patch
ModMetaData.author: Regions and Societies Team
ModMetaData.description:
Version: v0.1.0
Compatibility patch: Vanilla Outposts Expanded outposts are classified, populated and owned under Regions and Societies territory rules; world generation seeds VOE outposts around settlements; and outpost placement respects regional ownership.
Features: - Typed binding: outposts are recognised by real type and report their real occupant count as population, weighing into ownership and demographics. - Placement respects ownership: when Regions and Societies refuses a tile, VOE's own placement check refuses it too, with the reason shown in VOE's UI. - Worldgen seeding: AI factions get outposts seeded around their settlements, picked by archetype (mining, logging, farming, hunting), named by the faction's own name-maker and staffed with a generated pawn.
Requires: Regions and Societies (either the standard or the Realistic Planets 2 edition) and Vanilla Outposts Expanded. No settings of its own - governance toggles live in Regions and Societies.
--- Changelog (v0.1.0) --- - Initial release: Outposts integration extracted from Regions and Societies core into a typed compatibility patch binding the Outposts assembly directly.
Source: https://github.com/Regions-and-societies/VOE-CP Support development: https://ko-fi.com/archdukejim
